decision_rationale: trust_remote_code=True loading via AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained fails in the main .venv (transformers 5.16.1) with the same all_tied_weights_keys AttributeError seen in the original Day 5A M0 Phase 0 run, now confirmed even via the correct loading path discovered in Phase 0D (model.predict(), no external tokenizer).
